// diagnostic

E0749

A function reaches an effect outside a ceiling it answers to (a package `authority` `allow` row or a module `#FX(…)` cap), or one a `-[!E]>` row, module cap or package `deny` prohibits, including a denied `Panic` stop

What

A function reaches an effect outside a ceiling it answers to (a package `authority` `allow` row or a module `#FX(…)` cap), or one a `-[!E]>` row, module cap or package `deny` prohibits, including a denied `Panic` stop

Why

The registered sema rule names the effect or panic site, the call chain that reaches it and the scope that set the limit

Fix

Remove the offending effect, return a fallible result, add facts or a `#Pre`/refinement proof, widen the ceiling, or drop the prohibition

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0749: tests/ui/build_io_net_denied.stderr.

Error [jet.ProhibitedEffectReached]: `offline_banner` reaches the `Net` effect, which it prohibits with `-[!Net]>`
  --> tests/ui/build_io_net_denied.jet:6:25
    |
  6 | offline_banner: fn() -[!Net]> String {
    |                         ^^^
 Why: A `-[!Net]>` row means the function and every callee it can reach must not use `Net`
 Fix: Remove the call that introduces `Net`, or drop the `-[!Net]>` prohibition
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: offline_banner
